# cduyzh Mac Apps Catalog

> A collection of focused, lightweight native macOS utilities crafted by cduyzh (Chengdu, Sichuan, China).

Portal URL: https://apps.cduyzh.top/
Chinese Portal: https://apps.cduyzh.top/zh.html
Sitemap: https://apps.cduyzh.top/sitemap.xml
Author Profile: https://www.cduyzh.top/

## Released Apps & Product Pages

- [iScreenshot](https://apps.cduyzh.top/iScreenshot/): Native macOS menu-bar screenshot, scrolling long capture, color loupe, and frame studio.
- [极速截屏 iScreenshot 中文版](https://apps.cduyzh.top/iScreenshot/zh.html): 原生轻量 Mac 截图、长图滚动拼接、屏幕取色与样机美化。
- [iTrans](https://apps.cduyzh.top/iTrans/): Native macOS menu-bar translator powered by DeepSeek and Google with private local terminology memory.
- [极译 AI iTrans 中文版](https://apps.cduyzh.top/iTrans/zh.html): 原生 Mac 划词极速翻译软件，自带 DeepSeek API Key 官方直连，免订阅月租。

## Forthcoming Mac Utilities

- ProcessLens: Real-time CPU, memory, and process monitor.
- DiskSweep: Fast disk cleanup and duplicate file finder.
- MenuBarTidy: Menu bar icon organizer.
- WallpaperLoop: Video and photo dynamic wallpaper manager.
- MediaSaver: Video collector, Live Photo and GIF generator.
- TouchFlow: Trackpad gesture enhancements and window controls.
